judged_text: The `update` action persists nothing — it re-renders the same OpenStruct from fetch_embedding — and its only client caller, `saveChanges` in admin-embedding.js.es6, is triggered by no element in embedding.hbs, leaving the PUT /admin/customize/embedding route and the controller action inert. adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` without mutating anything (the model is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`), so the PUT endpoint can’t persist changes. On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no element invoking `saveChanges`, so the PUT route/action are currently unused/inert. This isn’t a user-facing defect yet because there are no embedding-level editable fields shown, but it is a diff-grounded maintainability trap: the presence of a PUT route + controller action that always returns a success-shaped payload could mislead future work into assuming save plumbing exists.
